name: cWB ANN classifier (Vinciguerra et al. 2017)
source: Section 2 (8x8 frame input, multilayer perceptrons, average of 4 ANNs, Fig. 2) and Table B2 (architecture IN 64, H 16/32/16, OUT 1)
unknowns: Activation functions are not stated (the networks are ROOT TMultiLayerPerceptron objects); the output is unbounded, so no activation is drawn
The second step, a multivariate ranking statistic that combines the ANN average with the cWB variables rho and cc, is a separate classifier and is not drawn
Fig. 2 (the schematic of the ANN) was not compared against the text beyond the layer sizes
notes: Training: 16384 background events and 16384 signal events, 650 epochs, conjugate gradients (Fletcher-Reeves). Four independently trained ANNs are averaged into the statistic <ANN>.
